task_manifest.prompt: A dog matching the reference image walks slowly toward the camera across dry grass, lowering its head toward the ground while its legs take alternating steps. The fence and bushes remain in the surrounding garden.
target_features: dark coat contrasting with pale source
longer dark furry silhouette; fine facial identity unresolved at small scale
source_events: local0 to8: head stays low as front paws alternate and body approaches camera
local8 to16: subject becomes more frontal with continuing steps and raised moving tail
limitations: R1 crouched/low with legs partly hidden; R2 standing side view in opposite orientation
small target pixel support and low facial detail; no zoom applied

task_manifest.prompt: A person matching the reference image dances on a paved courtyard in front of seated spectators. The person steps forward, uncrosses the legs and extends one leg while lowering the raised arm. The spectators and surrounding courtyard remain visible.
target_features: light pink flared skirt with contrasting pink hem lines
dark braided hair rather than source light tied hair

local8 to16: legs open to wider stance and forward foot extends while arm lowers
limitations: R1 back/side view; R2 frontal with both arms raised and one leg lifted
face small and motionblur; same public track not biometric identity proof
